artifacts.notes: One complete page image of printed columns 509-510, Commentariorum in Danielem, chapter III: Jerome's statement that the Hebrew text breaks off at Daniel 3:23-24 and that what follows to the end of the Canticle of the three youths is not in the Hebrew, and his comments on vv. 26, 29, 37, 39, 46 and 49, with Vallarsi's notes a-d. Retained because the volume's scan is too large to hold; the Wikisource transcription of this work is a separate, unchecked edition.
artifacts.rights_basis: The 1845 Paris printing is in the public domain in the United States: the repository's own rights reading, recorded at guidance/missals.md section 5, is that a work first published abroad before 1931 is in the public domain with no term running. A faithful photographic reproduction of one page of a public-domain printing adds no original authorship of its own. No modern editorial text is added by this retention.
